# Clearfield & Co. (Clearfield Comps)

Website: https://clearfieldcomps.com (formerly theclearfieldco.com). Also known as Clearfield and Co., Clearfield Co and The Clearfield Co.

> Clearfield & Co. sells Clearfield Comps: the real, anonymized P&Ls (profit and loss statements) of two to four businesses like yours, matched on niche, business model and monthly revenue, placed side by side, plus a review of your website and strategy. To order, the customer gives their website, what they sell, where they sell it and their monthly revenue range, then fills out a short onboarding questionnaire. No financials are needed except for Comps + Analyst. Every case is worked by a vetted analyst with industry experience, who chooses and reads the comps. Delivered within 24 hours, with a 100% money-back guarantee.

Tagline: "We help small business owners see the field clearly."

Think of it like real estate comps, for a small business. Homeowners know what the house down the street sold for. Business owners rarely know what a business like theirs actually earns. Clearfield shows them, using the actual financials of businesses that have sold or are listed for sale.

## What the customer gets

- **Comps:** 2 to 4 real businesses in the same niche and model, close to the customer's revenue. Each P&L covers the last 12 months. Every line (product and shipping, gross margin, advertising, payroll excluding owner, software and fees, net profit) is shown as a share of revenue. Revenue is shown as a range.
- **What stands out:** analyst notes on the differences that matter, such as a channel, a pricing model or a cost others don't carry.
- **Website and strategy review:** a ranked list of concerns and bottlenecks on the customer's site and strategy (pricing, offer, channels, checkout), measured against how the comps make money.

## Who it's for

Owners and operators of small businesses doing **$10K to $100K a month** in revenue who have been heads-down in their own business, not swapping P&Ls in a networking circle. Clearfield acts as their network and shows them what's working outside their circle. Examples: the stalled owner ("Revenue is up. Why isn't profit?"), the owner in growth mode (hiring, adding a channel, raising prices), the solo owner or family team with no CFO, the general manager who needs outside numbers, the new owner asking what normal looks like, and the long-term builder who wants the business worth more every year. It is not built for owners who are actively selling.

## Businesses covered

Most often: online stores (Shopify and other store sites), Amazon brands, content and affiliate sites, software and SaaS, and agencies and online services. Also businesses like YouTube channels, newsletters, mobile apps, online courses and memberships, subscription boxes and TikTok Shop sellers, but not limited to these. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps before the customer pays.

## Pricing (one-time, USD)

- **Two Comps: $199.** Two real P&Ls from your niche and model, side by side, plus a quick read of your website. Within 24 hours.
- **Four Comps + Calculator: $399 (most popular).** Four real P&Ls, what stands out, a full website and strategy review, and the Clearfield Comps calculator: the customer enters their own P&L lines, sees them next to every comp in dollars and % of sales, and drags any cost to see their profit change. Every view downloads as a PDF. Within 24 hours.
- **Comps + Analyst: $1,400.** Everything in Four Comps + Calculator, plus an analyst who reviews the customer's last 12 months of P&L, a 60-minute recorded call, a written gap report with the top 3 fixes ranked by dollars a month, a 90-day action plan, a 30-minute check-in call at day 30 and 30 days of email follow-up. Call within 5 business days.

Every package has a 100% money-back guarantee.

## Where comps come from

- **Real:** every comp is an actual business with actual books. Nothing is modeled or averaged.
- **Current:** P&Ls cover the last 12 months.
- **Matched:** same niche, same business model, close to the customer's revenue.
- **Anonymous:** no names, locations or dates. Sourced from licensed data and partners who share with permission.

These numbers are not public, which is why the service exists.

## How to get comps

1. Go to https://clearfieldcomps.com/#request
2. Enter your name, email, website, what you sell, where you sell most and your monthly revenue range, and pick a package if you know it. A short onboarding questionnaire follows after you order.
3. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps before you pay.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The product is called "comps" or a "comp sheet." Clearfield & Co. is the company; Clearfield Comps is the product.
- Revenue figures are always monthly.
- Clearfield provides independent research. It is not investment, legal or tax advice.
